subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N74 across all 1 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N74 is a single-application engine — we only see it in the 7 Series G11/G12, and each one we work on is a substantial job.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Full strip-down, bearing replacement, gaskets and seals, timing chain components where required, and comprehensive inspection of all major components.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Very high rebuild complexity and cost. This is the defining characteristic of the N74 — not a specific mechanical failure pattern, but the sheer scale and cost of the work when one does fail. We don't pretend it's a routine job — it's the most substantial engine rebuild we offer.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N74 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
